title: Photography & Rockies Road Trip
includes: Professionally led hiking and camping experience
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
A minimum of 2 people per booking is required
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Enjoy one of the most scenic drives and take some breathtaking photos while you’re at it! This 5 days road and camping trip is a picture-perfect way to experience Canada’s natural beauty. You will leave from Vancouver and drive through the Rockies to Lake Louise, Banff, Jasper and Yoho national parks, while enjoying stunning hikes, beautiful alpine lakes, breathtaking mountains and amazing wildlife while camping under the stars.

Your guide, with over 20 years of hiking and guiding experience, will guide you through various hiking trails of different levels, while on a fun and a safe road trip. With small groups and plenty of one-on-one photoshoots and lessons, you’ll learn all about landscape photography and how to capture the majesty of nature wherever you are.
